Module it.polimi.ingsw
Package it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Cards

Class PlayableCard

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.Model.Cards.PlayableCard
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Direct Known Subclasses:
FirstCardCreator, GoldCardCreator, ResourceCardCreator
public class PlayableCard extends Object implements Serializable
Represents a playable card in the game, which can be a gold card, initial card, or resource card. Each card has two faces (front and back), and methods to access its attributes, such as type, color, corners, points, objective, cost, and current active face.
